# proxmox_node_wakeonlan (Resource)

Sends a Wake-on-LAN packet through `POST /nodes/{node}/wakeonlan`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_wakeonlan" "w" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mac` (String) MAC address that was woken.
